'''This planet''' was an abandoned [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] world. It was orbited at some point by an [[Alpha facility]].

During the [[Rise of the Empire era]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] sent [[Trade Federation ship (Sith world)|ships]] to investigate the planet.

==Behind the scenes==
This planet was created by [[Syd Mead]] for the [[2010]] book ''[[Star Wars Art: Visions]]''. Mead took inspiration for his piece ''Abandoned Sith World'' from the film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].
